content:
elaine: deploy-bot paused canary for release 2026.03.20 due to postupgrade job failure. it looks like the DB migration job is waiting on a manual step. can we approve a short release-window exemption to run the migration and unblock the canary?

deploy-bot: Canary pause triggered: postupgrade-job failed on replica set rds-eu-west-1. Reason: "migration requires manual checksum confirmation". See logs: https://internal-logs/release/3342109876 :robot_face:

sam: any logs snippet? can you paste the failing error?

elaine: here's the relevant tail: 
```
2026-03-20T10:12:02Z ERROR migration-runner: checksum mismatch for migrations/20260320_add_partition.sql expected=0x3f1a actual=0x3f2b
Action required: run `dbctl verify-migration --confirm` after manual review
```

tj: ok. two options: 1) rollback the chart to v1.12.3 and re-run canary (fast), 2) allow manual confirm and proceed with canary (needs release-window extension). prefer to avoid rollback if migration is intentional.

sam: if we do manual confirm we should pin the chart + helm values so deploy-bot doesn't auto-promote a follow-up image mid-migration. i can push an annotation to lock chart: `release.redwood/pinned: "true" chart=service-api@v1.13.0`

release-manager-jane: current change window ends in 20m. i can approve a 45m extension for this release if eng owns monitoring and rollback plan. please post rollback steps and release-note blurb. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-sre: i'll be on watch. if latency > 200ms or error rate spikes > 2% i'll trigger rollback. share the pod and job names.

elaine: rollback plan: 
- helm rollback service-api --namespace prod --to-revision 42 (chart v1.12.3)
- scale down postupgrade job: `kubectl delete job postupgrade-job-20260320 -n prod` if stuck
- database: restore from logical backup from 10:00 UTC if migration partially applied (backup path: s3://backups/prod/20260320-10)
I will own the manual migration step.

sam: release notes snippet (for publishing): 
"Service API: DB migration for partitioning (2026-03-20). Migration requires manual checksum confirmation. Canary paused; manual migrate planned under extended window. No user-facing downtime expected. Rollback plan prepared."

elaine: command i'll run after approval: 
```bash
# pin chart + set migration flag to manual-confirm
kubectl annotate deployment/service-api release.redwood/pinned=true --namespace prod
helm upgrade --install service-api charts/service-api --namespace prod --version 1.13.0 \
  --set migration.manualConfirm=true --set image.tag=2026.03.20-canary
# run migration confirm after verifying checksum
dbctl verify-migration --path migrations/20260320_add_partition.sql --confirm
```

release-manager-jane: approved +45m. tagging @oncall-sre @tj. please log start/end in release-log and update the release note when done. :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: acknowledged. I'll tail logs and set a Grafana alert dashboard link.

tj: i'm standing by to rollback if needed. if you want me to run the helm rollback, ping me with `@tj rollback` in this thread.

deploy-bot: Manual action required: canary remains paused until migration confirmation. Runbook: https://internal/wiki/runbooks/canary-manual-migration

elaine: starting migration confirm in 2m. will post status updates here.

(elapsed ~20m)

elaine: migration confirm completed, all checks passed. Postupgrade job finished for canary subset.

deploy-bot: Canary resumed: postupgrade job succeeded on 3/3 canary pods. Promotion to stable scheduled per rollout policy. :rocket:

sam: added release-note entry and bumped docs. thanks everyone.

release-manager-jane: closed window at +40m. nice work.

oncall-sre: monitoring shows error rate remained normal during migration, all good.

elaine: closing thread — will follow up in release notes channel with final artifacts. :tada:
